metadata.title: Emoto - Twitch Emote Guessing Game
metadata.description: Guess Twitch emotes from your favorite streamer's channel in this fun guessing game!
metadata.keywords: Twitch, emotes, game, emote guessing, BTTV, 7TV, Twitch emotes, streaming

scoreMessages.zero: Try again, you can do it!
scoreMessages.high: Impressive! You know your emotes well.

help.title: How to Play
help.description: Guess the Twitch emotes from your favorite streamer's channel.
instructions: Enter a Twitch channel name → the game loads ALL emotes (BTTV + 7TV)
You have 3 lives. Game over when you run out!
help.gameDescription: Emoto is a Twitch emote guessing game.

offline.title: You're Offline
offline.description: Please check your internet connection and try again.

intermediate.title: Emoter
intermediate.description: Guess 25 emotes correctly. You're getting the hang of it!

advanced.title: Enthusiast
advanced.description: Guess 50 emotes. Emotes have no secrets from you!

expert.title: Expert
expert.description: Guess 100 emotes. Your skill is impressive!

master.title: Emote Master
master.description: Guess 250 emotes. You're a legend in the emote world!

legend.title: Living Legend
legend.description: Guess 500 emotes. You've transcended the emote world!

immortal.title: Emote Immortal
immortal.description: Guess 1000 emotes. You're an emote deity!

o_incidente.title: O Incidente
o_incidente.description: Guess 15 emotes from O Incidente group channels (cereaw, grifoexe, eo_chara, tinymigs, akkaiverso)
